item.title: Hong Kong: HKUST Leads in AI, Energy and Infrastructure Research
item.description: HKUST leads funding round with projects advancing AI, resilient infrastructure, low-altitude systems and clean energy while accelerating translational research impact.

item.title: The Philippines: Butuan City Accelerating Digital Public Services
item.description: Butuan City is modernising government services by deploying digital platforms and tech-enabled systems, streamlining business permits and civil registry processes for faster, more efficient and citizen-centric access.

item.title: Malaysia-Türkiye Collaborate on AI, Advanced Manufacturing
item.description: Malaysia and Türkiye expand cooperation in defence, energy and high-technology sectors, focusing on innovation, advanced manufacturing and long-term industrial collaboration.

item.title: Australia: Drones Enable Non-Invasive Dolphin Health Monitoring
item.description: Australian researchers are using thermal imaging drones to monitor dolphin health non-invasively, measuring temperature and respiration while reducing stress and supporting conservation.

item.title: The Philippines: Smart Villages Initiative Connects Remote Communities
item.description: The initiative expands internet access, services and telemedicine to isolated communities, advancing inclusive digital transformation in Northern Mindanao.

item.title: Hong Kong: AI Accelerates Cross-Border E-Commerce Growth
item.description: A Hong Kong-based AI-driven cross-border e-commerce platform secures Series C funding to expand automation, optimise logistics and accelerate seamless, efficient, reliable, scalable international online trade.

item.title: Vietnam: Advancing Innovation Ecosystem for Double-digit Growth
item.description: Vietnam strengthens its innovation and digital transformation ambitions with a new R&D centre, talent development initiatives and a technology-driven growth strategy for 2026 and beyond.

item.title: Australia: AI-Powered Meal Plans Boost Weight Loss Success
item.description: CSIRO research shows that personalised meal plans, now enhanced with AI, significantly improve weight loss outcomes for Australians, supporting healthier habits, sustainable results and tailored nutrition strategies.

item.title: India: Smart Technology Drives Dairy Sector Transformation
item.description: India’s dairy sector is undergoing a major digital transformation, using technology to improve livestock management, milk collection, processing, logistics and data-driven operational and strategic decision-making.

item.title: Singapore: AI Challenge Launched to Tackle Chronic Diseases
item.description: Singapore’s AI Innovation Challenge 2026 engages students in developing multilingual, culturally aware AI solutions using MERaLiON and SEA-LION to detect, prevent and effectively manage chronic diseases.
